in_marathi.name: Bichitra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Picture of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bichitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bichitra refers to the intricate design of the universe. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bichitra' meaning 'variegated, multicolored, or intricate' and 'ra' meaning 'creation' or 'universe'. This name is often given to a child born under the stars, signifying the vastness and complexity of the cosmos.
